slot.brief: Two long parallel wires carrying given currents; find magnetic field (magnitude and direction) at a point on a line between or outside them.

stem: Two long parallel wires lie in the plane of the page at $x=0$ and $x=0.30$ m. They carry currents of $5$ A and $8$ A upward, respectively. Find the magnetic field at $x=-0.10$ m.

verdicts.working: For upward currents, the field to the left of each wire is out of the page. Magnitudes: wire at x=0 gives 2×10⁻⁷(5/0.10)=10 μT; wire at x=0.30 m gives 2×10⁻⁷(8/0.40)=4 μT. The fields add to 14 μT out of the page.

working:
$r_1=0.10\ \text{m},\quad r_2=0.40\ \text{m}$
$B_1=2\times10^{-7}\dfrac{5}{0.10}=10\ \mu\text{T},\quad B_2=2\times10^{-7}\dfrac{8}{0.40}=4\ \mu\text{T}$
$B_{\text{net}}=B_1+B_2=14\ \mu\text{T}$
Right-hand rule: both fields point out of the page.

Independent check: For upward currents, the field to the left of each wire is out of the page. Magnitudes: wire at x=0 gives 2×10⁻⁷(5/0.10)=10 μT; wire at x=0.30 m gives 2×10⁻⁷(8/0.40)=4 μT. The fields add to 14 μT out of the page.
